P: 1. Activate EMS/stroke pathway immediately; establish exact last-known-well and witness contact, obtain point-of-care glucose and urgent brain/vascular imaging through the stroke team; keep oral intake withheld until swallow safety is assessed; explain time-sensitive treatment eligibility and do not delay transfer to complete an elective exam or note.

2. Check bedside glucose immediately and treat a confirmed low value through the emergency team; reassess neurologic deficits afterward without abandoning stroke evaluation if they persist; explain that metabolic mimics need rapid testing.

3. Obtain urgent brain imaging through the stroke pathway to assess structural causes; involve neurology if a mass is identified; explain that this lower-probability possibility cannot be confirmed by the history and must not delay emergency assessment.
